title: Buff Banners
description: Hostile mobs can spawn with Buff Banners that grant combat buffs.
body:
# Buff Banners

## Features

### Spawn-Based Banner Drops

- **5% chance** for trackable hostile mobs to spawn wearing their own banner
- Killing these special mobs drops their banner item
- **Supported mobs:** All vanilla hostile mobs except:
  - Ender Dragon
  - Wither
  - Elder Guardian

### Aura Radius & Clustering

![Banner Radius](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c0482234fbdd4685a4b63652a658a0f8905b45a_0.webp)

Place a banner to create a mob-specific combat zone:

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Base Radius | 16 blocks |
| Support Radius | 5 blocks (between banners) |
| Radius per Support | +8 blocks |
| Maximum Radius | 128 blocks |

**How it works:** Only same-type banners within 5 blocks of the main banner count as supports. Each support banner increases the main banner's effective radius.

### Buff Effects

Players inside an banner radius receive powerful combat bonuses:

- **+35% attack damage** against that mob type
- **35% reduced incoming damage** from that mob type

### Visuals

- **Hold any mob banner** (main hand or offhand) to display the buff radius using particles.
